position_beats.in_element: The position of the `Element` in the `Clip`
position_beats.in_section: The position of the `Section`, to be added to the positions of the respective `Element`s encapsulated by it

ontology.tied_to_previous: Notes can only be tied to the previous `Note`, so, they work as duration extension of the previous one
ontology.accidental: The accidentals are chromatic offsets on the Key Signature and NOT on the Major Scale necessarily
ontology.diatonic_mode_0: This is the mode of the Diatonic scale, where `0` means Major and `5` means minor
